exposure: Timing of urinary catheter removal (immediate, 6 hours, 24 hours)
outcome: rate of urinary retention with recatheterization
rate of symptomatic urinary tract infections
cohort: 221 women who underwent term elective Cesarean section.
finding: Removal of the urinary catheter 6 hours postoperatively appears to be more advantageous than early or late removal in cases of Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Removal of urinary catheter 6 hours after Cesarean section was associated with lower morbidity than immediate or delayed removal.
